lines.text: (اگر تسدیس باشد) دلالت کند بر قوة اهل صلاح و قضاة و وزراء و تشریف
lines.en: (If it is a sextile) it indicates the strength of the people of righteousness, judges, viziers, and the honoring

lines.text: یافتن از ملوك و سلاطین کبار و آبادانی مدارس و مساجد و سایر بقاع خیر و
lines.en: received from kings and great sultans, and the flourishing of schools, mosques, and other places of goodness, and

lines.text: منفعت یافتن علما و طلاب از پادشاه و ظهور نشادیها و بدست امدن کتابهای قدیم و تربیت
lines.en: the benefit received by scholars and students from the king, and the appearance of joys, and the acquisition of old books, and the upbringing

lines.text: یافتن اهل علم و کثرت خیرات اکابر و زیاده شدن مالها (تثلیث تسدیس زهره و مشتری)
lines.en: received by the people of knowledge, and the abundance of charities of the great ones, and the increase of wealth. (Trine and sextile of Venus and Jupiter)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر رونق اهل ادیان و خوشحالی علما و قضاة و اشراف و توفر اهل طرب
lines.en: It indicates the prosperity of the people of religions, and the happiness of scholars, judges, and nobles, and the abundance of the people of joy

lines.text: و سعادت زنان و خادمان و عزت پیرایه و ملبوسا و عطر نایت و کرانی برده و خوشی
lines.en: and the happiness of women and servants, and the honor of ornaments and clothing, and the fragrance of perfume, and the dearness of slaves, and the pleasantness

lines.text: معیشت خلایق و ارزانی نرخها و اعتدال هوا و نمو در وقت و صحت خلایق و موافقت
lines.en: of the livelihood of the creatures, and the cheapness of prices, and the moderation of the air, and growth in time, and the health of the creatures, and the agreement

lines.text: ازواج و بسیاری مناکحت و مواصلت و کثرت زهد در زنان و تقید ایشان بدین و عفت
lines.en: of spouses, and the abundance of marriage and union, and the abundance of asceticism in women, and their adherence to religion and chastity.

lines.text: (اگر تثلیث باشد) دلالت کند بر قوة کار بزرگان و سعادت وزراء و اشراف و صحت
lines.en: (If it is a trine) it indicates the strength of the work of the great ones, and the happiness of viziers and nobles, and the health

lines.text: بیماران و باصلاح امدن کارها و وقوع نکاحها و ساختن زینتها و ارام گرفتن فتنها
lines.en: of the sick, and the improvement of affairs, and the occurrence of marriages, and the making of ornaments, and the calming of seditions

lines.text: و حرمت خواتین و اهل مزامیر و امدن اخبار ساره و کثرت تصدق و امانت در خلق
lines.en: and the respect of ladies and the people of musical instruments, and the arrival of glad tidings, and the abundance of almsgiving and trustworthiness among the people

lines.text: و حرص مردم بطاعت و عبادت و نیکی افعال و اعمال ملوك و رفتن مردم باماكن شریفه
lines.en: and the eagerness of the people for obedience and worship, and the goodness of the actions and deeds of kings, and the going of the people to noble places

lines.text: و زیارت مزارات متبرکه و توبه از بدیها (و اگر تسدیس باشد) دلالت کند بر سلامتی
lines.en: and the visitation of blessed shrines, and repentance from bad deeds. (And if it is a sextile) it indicates the safety

lines.text: حال علما و پیوستن شادیها و الفت و موافقت میان این طایفه و اسایش و خوشدلی
lines.en: of the condition of scholars, and the joining of joys, and affection and agreement among this group, and comfort and happiness

lines.text: عامه و شادی و طرب در میان ایشان و قیمت لباس ابریشمی و عزت پیرایه زنان و کثرت
lines.en: of the common people, and joy and mirth among them, and the price of silk clothing, and the honor of women's ornaments, and the abundance

lines.text: عیش در علما و اشراف و رونق قضاة و سادات و صلح میان مردم (تثلیث و تسدیس عطارد و مشتری)
lines.en: of pleasure among scholars and nobles, and the prosperity of judges and sayyids, and peace among the people. (Trine and sextile of Mercury and Jupiter)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر رونق اهل فضل و علما و قوت دبیران و مستوفیان و ارباب قلم و متصرفان
lines.en: It indicates the prosperity of the people of virtue and scholars, and the strength of secretaries and accountants and the masters of the pen and administrators

lines.text: و تجار و متصدیان و راستی مردم در امور و مهمات و معاملات و تیزی بازارها و ایمنی شوارع
lines.en: and merchants and officials, and the honesty of the people in affairs and important matters and transactions, and the briskness of markets, and the safety of streets

lines.text: و راستی اخبار و بمیان فتادن سخنان حق و نوشتن امثله و قبالجات و راستی در عدول و
lines.en: and the truthfulness of news, and the spreading of true words, and the writing of examples and deeds, and honesty in the just and

lines.text: راست شدن معالجات اطبا و احکام اهل تنجیم و ارزانی نرخها و هبوب ریاح خاصه که
lines.en: the correctness of the treatments of physicians and the judgments of astrologers, and the cheapness of prices, and the blowing of winds, especially if

lines.text: در برج بادی باشند (اگر تثلیث باشد) دلالت کند بر قوت حال شعراء و اطبا و متکلمان
lines.en: they are in an airy sign. (If it is a trine) it indicates the strength of the condition of poets, physicians, and theologians

lines.text: و رونق مساجد و مدارس و رواج بازار کتاب و اعتدال هوا و مناظره اهل علم بی نفاق
lines.en: and the prosperity of mosques and schools, and the briskness of the book market, and the moderation of the air, and the debate of the people of knowledge without hypocrisy

lines.text: و عناد و جمعیت این طایفه و سعادت اهل حرفه و صنعت و عزت برده و باد و باران
lines.en: and stubbornness, and the gathering of this group, and the happiness of the people of crafts and industry, and the honor of slaves, and wind and rain

sections.en: Trine and sextile of Venus and Jupiter

summary.headline: Trines and Sextiles of Benefics
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of trine and sextile aspects involving Venus and Jupiter, followed by Mercury and Jupiter. The passages associate these configurations with prosperity, scholarship, religious life, marriage, markets, truthful news, medicine, poetry, weather, and social peace.
